harness: AgentDojo 0.1.35 (logged agentdojo_package_version 0.1.35 in 53,307 logs, phase-10c census) from git dependency Wakeful-Cloud/agentdojo@6ebf27e7 (pyproject.toml [tool.uv.sources]) = upstream v0.1.35 + 2 crash fixes; benchmark v1.2.2 (logged benchmark_version v1.2.2 in all logs). Agent element: PromptingLLM (text-parsed tool calls) over an OpenAI-compatible Ollama endpoint (http://localhost:11434/v1), ToolsExecutionLoop (AgentDojo default max_iters 15), sequential workers, force_rerun=False (resumable: interrupted runs were resumed, per READMEs). Known bugs of this code relevant to the logs: (1) temperature: openai_llm.chat_completion_request sends `temperature or NOT_GIVEN`, so 0.0 is never sent and the server default applies (upstream PR #141, fixed 2026-02-03, after the runs) - runs are sampled, not greedy; (2) the two crash bugs (empty tool call, ellipsis argument) hit runs started before 2025-11-21/24 (the earliest log is 2025-11-18 07:05 per our phase-10c census), so early logs ran unpatched code; (3) security_from_traces counts proposed calls (#168/#189), relevant to aborted runs in slack IT5; (4) llm-lock's own code: embedding_defense.detect returns (is_benign, p_mal), which EnhancedPromptInjectionDetector reads as (is_injection, score) - the pinned embedding defence would abort on a benign classification; the transformer arms' README says a bug inverted classification probabilities and the values were 'fixed after the fact'; the redacting branch of EnhancedPromptInjectionDetector is dead code at the pin (raise precedes transform) although three arms redact.
models: Agent: NOT RECORDED in any log (pipeline_name 'local' in 52,722 logs, 'transformer' in 585). Code default --llm-api-model/LLM_API_MODEL = hf.co/unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct-GGUF:Q3_K_XL (main.py l. 199-202; scripts/start-ollama.sh is called with it in run.sh); served by Ollama on 1x A100 80GB (ICRN; Campus Cluster for part of multiclass). Upstream PR #136 by the same author says the fixed crashes occurred running with Ollama + Llama 4 (https://github.com/ethz-spylab/agentdojo/pull/136), and the none-arm run README cites those two fixes as interrupting the runs [corrected 2026-10-14 fact-check: only the none README]: documentary support for 'Llama 4' (family), not for the exact variant/quantisation. Our policy D-92: unk /model not_recorded.
Detector LLM (llm, multiclass arms): hf.co/unsloth/Qwen3-8B-GGUF:Q5_K_XL via Ollama (run READMEs, run.sh)

Embedding: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + scikit-learn random forest (embedding, hybrid: trained on jayavibhav/prompt-injection-safety; multiclass: random-forest-goal on the synthetic dataset) (run.sh)

Transformer classifiers: protectai/deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection-v2 (benign label SAFE) and qualifire/prompt-injection-jailbreak-sentinel-v2 (benign label 'benign'); the hybrid/protectai arm is launched with qualifire in run.sh while its README names DeBERTa
Synthetic dataset generator model: not examined (not executions)
